title: Trump's AI push faces a local ballot test
hook_text: AI expansion hits local ballot tests
script:
AI expansion is hitting a major local speed bump.
Voters in several communities are weighing in on new data centers.
These facilities require massive amounts of electricity and water to function.
Local residents fear the environmental impact on their communities.
Donald Trump remains committed to his plan to accelerate AI capacity.
The tension centers on zoning laws and local management of resources.
Would you welcome a massive data center next door?
